_about: The homepage A pictures the feature rows do not have (hardpan-home.html: the fold's mosaic, the five scene cards and their sheets, the TV board tile). Real captures only. The four phone screens are the 2.0.7 App Store captures (outbox/appstore-207-submit/iphone-6.9, iPhone 6.9-inch), the phone screen cut out of Apple's frame (x 190-1130, y 722-2762 of 1320x2868 = 940x2040) with sips, encoded to WebP in Chrome (canvas, quality .82): 940 for the viewer, 400 for the card. The two board pictures were shot from hardpangolf.com on 2026-11-15 15:44 (event R7SK48, Test 46A at Papago, a demo event with no scores): tournament-tv at 1400x844 at 2x (1400 + 700 WebP) and tournament at 390 wide at 2x (780 + 400 WebP). Not in sw.js's shell list, not in the native bundle. The weekly-results App Store capture (as-04) is NOT used: it shows dollar amounts and the marketing page carries none.
